methodology.scope: Only this blind-assessment directory and its provided artifacts were read. Conditions were not inferred. No external contact or application submission occurred.
methodology.inspection: Read all twelve pair.md files. For document pairs 01 and 05, opened actual DOCX ZIP packages, checked ZIP integrity, parsed main-body document.xml, compared the provided body extractions, and visually inspected every provided PNG (four total).
methodology.source_limit: Citation tokens in PageUp responses were not treated as inspected source evidence. No linked source content was provided or opened; no current platform-source verification is claimed.
methodology.word_counts: Counts refer to visible applicant prose, excluding writing-block directives, citation serialization and standalone formatting marks. All maximum-length conclusions are comfortably within bounds; exact 60-word profiles were checked.
methodology.winner_rule: A literal frozen-check shortfall is recorded even when it does not amount to a consequential error. Winners require a consequential omission/error avoided without a comparable new problem. Optional dates, qualification years, redundant explanatory notes and style alone do not determine a winner.
methodology.corrections: Corrections lists contain required candidate actions before real use or missing application-completion checks. Optional changes that would improve literal frozen-check coverage are identified in reasons, not presented as mandatory submission fixes.
methodology.outcomes: No actual hiring, ATS parsing or acceptance success is inferred.

checks.reason: Inspected both actual application.docx ZIP packages and parsed word/document.xml, then inspected both page-1.png files. A is 37,358 bytes; B is 37,287 bytes. Each supplied rendering is one legible page, without clipping or overlap, and all substantive text is in body paragraphs.
